doc: Dash -> ability rows (DashFlow, docs/decisions/0010-dash-ability-flow.md). dash.<ground|air>.<lmb|rmb|e|x|q>: {mode: fire (mid-dash) | buffer (to the dash's end; the default for a missing row) | cancel (ends the dash), carry: dash momentum kept into it, variant: a dash-variant name the kit reads, source: what the source hero does}. into_dash.<slot>: the same for Shift pressed during that ability's wind-up or recovery. kit_owns: the dashes (ground, air) the kit runs in its own state, out of DashFlow's sight until it overrides ArchKit.in_dash(). Combo rows (docs/decisions/0015-combo-flow.md): jump.<slot> (a press mid-jump: fire | buffer to the landing), into_jump.<slot> (a jump in the ability's wind-up or recovery: fire | cancel | buffer | lock; into_dash takes the same modes and an optional air sub-row), hold.<slot>.<ground|air|jump|mantle> (a held slot through that move: keep | cancel). A missing row combines; any other row is an exception and carries a reason and a source.

lmb.source: data: Spin Dash dashes forward and hits round him; footage 0371: one hammer spin on arrival. The hammer is busy in the spin, so a throw, recall or swing goes when the dash ends (no footage of the pair)

rmb.source: data: Brightshield is a 0.1 s hold, nothing locks it out in the Spin Dash: the aegis rises mid-dash (Shift with it already up is the Shield Bash, see RMB -> dash)

e.source: data: Regen Field drops round the hammer wherever it is and doesn't move him, so it goes mid-dash (no footage of the pair)

x.source: data: Abyssalbreaker sends a fissure from where he stands; footage f25-f31: he is planted for the slam. It ends the dash where he is (no footage of the pair)

lmb.source: footage section 5: no air dash shown; as the ground dash, the hammer goes when the shove ends

rmb.source: no air dash in the footage; as the ground dash

e.source: no air dash in the footage; as the ground dash

x.source: no air dash in the footage; as the ground dash, the slam plants him where he is

lmb.source: wiki (Spin Dash): Shift while charging the Hammer Smash ends it in a short dash without the spin, on a reduced cooldown (ours: half a charge back)

rmb.source: data: Brightshield + Shift is the Shield Bash (6 s, its own cooldown), the shield briefly invulnerable; the aegis stays up through it

e.source: data: Regen Field stays round the hammer; the dash doesn't touch it

x.source: footage f25-f31: planted through the wind-up and the slam; Shift there goes when the plant ends

ground.source: Wiki (Spin Dash): Shift while charging the Hammer Smash ends it in a short dash without the spin (into_dash.lmb); owner item 51 wants the hold kept. Ours today (measured by --dash-flow-check): the hold ends and the short dash goes.

air.source: No air dash in the footage. Ours today (measured by --dash-flow-check): the air dash (the lumber) ends the hold with no swing.

mantle.reason: owner item 30: a mantle ends the held Crushing Blow (item 51 keeps that)
mantle.source: Owner item 30; the source has no mantle rule.
